name: reference-mdr-smb-egress
note: REFERENCE profile, not a validated operator requirement set. Assumptions are stated and targets are frozen BEFORE any held-out run (§44.2). Do not fit thresholds to observed results.
assumptions: single-tenant SMB network, egress-monitored, no forensics/pcap overlay deployed (Parser -> Cernity -> SIEM MDR path)
investigator operates the arm's normal analyst surface only; no access to raw suppressed evidence the deployment does not expose
traffic mix is mostly benign with a small number of planted incidents and benign mimics
